title: SectionViewStyle group-2 line measurement overlay insertion
scope: Preserve typed bend-line length, end-line overshoot, and end-line length edits when raw group-2 code-40 values are absent
Exercise the third repeated value with default placeholders for the first two occurrences
Verify ordered raw replay and typed same-version readback

production: The same-version SectionViewStyle raw overlay inserts missing group-2 code-40 line measurements through the highest edited occurrence.
An end-line-length-only edit inserts default bend length and end-line overshoot values before the changed third value. Non-finite values refuse insertion.
tests: Generated ASCII and Binary controls remove all three group-2 code-40 values, default the first two typed fields, and edit the third.
The focused style selector compares the complete expected raw group sequence and verifies same-version typed readback alongside group-2 colors/weights and group-3 label controls.

limitations: This validates local generated same-version raw overlay and typed readback only. It does not qualify native producer field ordering, cross-version serialization, or CAD rendering.
